dedupe_keys.name: eurosystem household finance and consumption survey hfcs

description: A household-level survey of finances and consumption across euro area countries. The ECB page says the HFCS collects household data on assets, debts, income and consumption in waves: 2010 (fieldwork 2010-2011), 2014, 2017, 2021 (fieldwork 2020 to 2022, delayed by the pandemic) and 2023 (mainly 2023, some interviews from 2022 to 2025). Anonymised microdata are made available to researchers, and statistical tables, updated on 12 June 2026, and results reports are free downloads, with a dashboard by the Austrian central bank. Coverage is euro area and participating EU countries. Caveats: microdata access is limited to approved researchers, and fieldwork dates differ by country. For simulation it gives household savings, debts and liquid assets, to estimate how households cope with income losses or cash shortages after disasters or payment outages. A related catalogue record is the World Bank Global Findex database.
